name: Elder
persona: An elf older than the village trees; speaks slowly, asks for old magic to be brought back.

greet: Welcome, short-lived one. Walk softly here.
The trees told me you were coming.
quest: Bring me {need}, and the village will remember your name.
We lack {need}. Find it — the map hides it somewhere — and return.
thanks: {need}! The moon-wards wake again. Take our thanks.

say: {village} grew around the Tree of Gold before your kingdoms had names. Its leaves turn with our trust in you.
We are few, and we are old. We need hands like yours.
